text:
alex: Quick preflight — we want to flip sealed-secrets to KMS-wrapped Vault (Vault uses GCP KMS for transit). Need to coordinate RBAC changes, audit logging verification, and credential rotation for long-lived CI/service tokens. Planning window: this week. Who can help?

maria: I can take the checklist. I'll open SEC-4821 with steps: (1) verify audit sink, (2) create rotator role/group, (3) rotate tokens in staging, (4) run git history scan, (5) run canary deploy then prod. ETA: 48h for staging.

jordan: On audit sink — make sure we have request_id in Vault audit device and that sinks go to BigQuery. Example: `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_audit.log` (we'll also enable `syslog` forwarder). Also verify `audit_non_hmac = true` for readable records.

sam: Note: GitHub Actions and Terraform SA keys are the usual suspects. Recommend running `trufflehog --since-commit HEAD~500 --json` across repos; I can run for infra and infra-configs.

tanvi: KMS details: Vault transit will use a GCP crypto key. Grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to `vault-sa@project.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Also confirm CMEK permissions for any GCS sinks.

sre-bot: auto-scan: found 2 potential secrets in `infra/configs` (masking applied) — creating follow-up ticket: INFRA-739. Link: https://go/redwood/infra/INFRA-739

security-bot: runbook link: https://go/redwood/sec/runbooks/secrets-rotation. Please update runbook with any vendor-specific steps. Remember to record rotation metadata (rotator, commit, token id) in SEC-4821.

luis: I can do the staging rotation tomorrow morning (09:30 PT). Can someone drop the list of tokens/keys that need rotating and which ones require revocation vs reissue?

alex: short list to start: `ci-deploy-key-prod` (rotate in staging then prod), `tf-service-account` (create new key, update CI, then revoke old), `helm-chart-publish` (token -> short-lived), `staging-connector` (ephemeral creds). We'll expand in SEC-4821.

maria: Proposal: create a `secrets-rotators` group in Okta, mapped to a Vault policy `rotator-policy` with `capabilities = ["update","read"]` on `secret/data/rotations/*` and `sys/rotate` where needed. Two approvers required for prod rotations. I'll draft the RBAC change and post diffs here.

jordan: Important: RBAC must only allow `secrets-rotators` to write rotation markers; actual key material ops should still be gated. We'll add audit hooks to alert on `token/revoke` and `auth/token/create` events.

tanvi: Also double-check audit retention: we need 90d by compliance. Confirm BigQuery export and Vault audit file archiving: set lifecycle rules on GCS.

sam: After staging rotates, I can run a smoke test script: `scripts/smoke/secrets-check.sh` that validates tokens for deploys and terraform plans. If smoke fails, rollback plan is to reinstate previous keys and open an outage call.

alex: perfect — maria + luis please coordinate staging tomorrow. Tag @oncall if anything goes wrong. I'll post a short pre/post checklist in SEC-4821. :thumbsup: 

maria: ack — will post RBAC draft in ~2h and ping the PR-approvers channel.

luis: Will also snapshot current audit logs and upload to SEC-4821 before rotation. Will share runbook notes.

alex: plan: canary prod only after 24h of clean staging. If all green, schedule prod rotation window Fri 22:00 PT. Any objections?

sam: no objections from infra. I'll be available in the window.

security-bot: reminder: ensure all rotations are recorded with `rotation_id` metadata and link to SEC-4821 for compliance evidence.

alex: thanks team — will follow up after staging run.
